Provider timeout cancels the async stream; resource-wait deadline and cancellation start no backend and leave no active lease; mutating execution timeout or cancellation after backend start is outcome_unknown; verification deadline cancels the verifier and returns verification_pending.
A blocked native provider does not block a fast session, same-session turns remain serialized, cancellation fences stale generation commits, and resource leases are released.
Frozen provider request hashes, provider commit before tool dispatch, model-view binding, pipeline stage order, evidence ordering, entry parity and retry contracts continue to pass.
